title: Add shop banner and logo from uploaded images

requirements.summary: Replace the existing hero banner on the homepage with the uploaded shop banner image showing the store interior, logo, Aadhar enabled payment system, stationery availability, and contact number
acceptanceCriteria: The shop banner image (IMG_20251019_102908.png) is displayed prominently at the top of the homepage
The banner maintains its aspect ratio and is responsive across different screen sizes
The banner replaces any existing hero/banner section on the homepage

file_operations.description: Replace the existing hero banner section with the uploaded shop banner image. Update the hero section to display IMG_20251019_102908.png (referenced as frontend/public/assets/shop-banner.png) as the main banner image. Ensure the image is responsive using appropriate CSS classes (e.g., w-full, object-cover) and maintains aspect ratio across different screen sizes. Remove or replace any existing hero text/content that conflicts with the banner image display.

requirements.summary: Replace the store logo in the header navigation with the uploaded circular logo image featuring the shopkeeper illustration and 'Maa Bhawani General Store' text in Hindi
acceptanceCriteria: The circular logo image (Gemini_Generated_Image_rjk9furjk9furjk9.png) appears in the header navigation
The logo is appropriately sized and maintains its circular shape
The logo links to the homepage when clicked
The logo is visible on all pages of the application

file_operations.description: Replace the existing store logo in the header with the uploaded circular logo image. Update the logo image source to reference Gemini_Generated_Image_rjk9furjk9furjk9.png (referenced as frontend/public/assets/store-logo.png). Ensure the logo maintains its circular shape using appropriate CSS (e.g., rounded-full, object-contain) and is sized appropriately for the header (e.g., h-12 w-12 or h-16 w-16). Verify the logo is wrapped in a Link component that navigates to the homepage ('/') when clicked.

requirements.summary: Store both uploaded images as static assets in the frontend/public/assets directory with descriptive filenames for easy reference and maintenance
acceptanceCriteria: Both images are saved in frontend/public/assets directory
Images are referenced using their static asset paths in the application
Images load correctly without any broken image links

file_operations.description: Copy the uploaded IMG_20251019_102908.png file to this location as shop-banner.png. This file serves as the main hero banner for the homepage showing the store interior, logo, Aadhar enabled payment system, stationery availability, and contact number.

Copy the uploaded Gemini_Generated_Image_rjk9furjk9furjk9.png file to this location as store-logo.png. This circular logo image features the shopkeeper illustration and 'Maa Bhawani General Store' text in Hindi, and will be used in the header navigation.
